decisions.reason: Reject for a visible source-uniform detail loss: the exact small original's viewer-left collar tab has two separated pale rank marks, also confirmed on the visually matched large original; the raw return replaces this pair with a single central diamond and omits the lower mark. Preserve that visible paired arrangement in an art repair. Otherwise the yellow mascot identity, green eyes, receding slicked-back gray hair and brows, smooth face without invented beard or glasses, closed neutral mouth, framed dark photographic backing, overlapping aged paper and its two-row mark-group arrangement are recognizable. Short broad head-to-collar fit and contact shading are coherent, without long yellow neck or pale belly patch. Actual RGBA has alpha range 0-255; the threshold-and-10px-eroded interior contains alpha251:376, alpha252:98880, alpha253:795340 and alpha254:2675, not alpha255. White/cyan views show visually solid clothing/backing/paper and no large interior hole; these near-opaque values are recorded honestly and are not the basis of this art rejection or a request for another generic alpha edit. Any stricter opacity qualification needs independent alpha investigation.
